teachingQuestion: How should business impact and trust shape a recovery strategy?
focalInsight: The right strategy restores a prioritized business service with trustworthy data and dependencies, not merely an available machine.
title: Recovery strategy decision
caption: Impact and recovery objectives guide the capability choice and acceptance evidence.

nodes.label: Business acceptance
nodes.detail: Owner accepts service and residual risk

altSummary: Business impact sets recovery objectives, which guide capability choice; trust validation supports business acceptance and future improvement.
textFallback: Identify the critical function and impact, define RTO, RPO, MTD, and integrity needs, choose redundancy, backup, alternate, or workaround capabilities, validate identity, keys, data, dependencies, and monitoring, then obtain business acceptance.
